About this item

  • 24 g High-Quality Whey Protein per Scoop – 100% of the protein from whey for a fast-absorbing, complete protein source that supports muscle maintenance and growth.
  • 5.5 g Naturally-Occurring BCAAs + 11g of naturally occurring EAAs – Delivers essential amino acids including leucine, isoleucine, and valine to support post-workout muscle recovery, muscle strength and muscle building when taken over time with regular resistance training.
  • Low Sugar, Low Carb, Low Fat — Ideal for Lean Muscle or Cutting Phases – With just ~1 g sugar, ~3 g carbs per serving, and whey protein isolate as the primary ingredient with further carbs and fat “isolated” out. It’s a high quality choice for athletes focused on lean muscle, weight management, or body-composition goals.
  • Instantized & Easy-Mix Formula (Great Mixability) – Designed to dissolve smoothly in water, milk, or smoothies with a spoon, shaker, or blender — perfect for fast post-workout shakes or convenient protein boosts.
  • Trusted Brand, Tested Quality & Versatile Use – For 35 years, athletes have trusted Optimum Nutrition to fuel their training. Gold Standard Whey is the trusted choice for gym-goers, athletes, and everyday fitness enthusiasts worldwide — use post-workout or as a protein supplement anytime.

Important information

Safety Information

For healthy adults, consume enough protein to meet your daily protein requirements with a combination of high protein foods and protein supplements throughout the day as part of a balanced diet and exercise program.

Ingredients

Protein Blend (Whey Protein Isolate, Whey Protein Concentrate, Hydrolyzed Whey Protein), Natural and Artificial Flavor, Sunflower and/or Soy Lecithin, Cellulose Gum, Xanthan Gum, Salt, Sucralose, Acesulfame Potassium. CONTAINS: MILK AND SOY.

Directions

Mix about one scoop of the powder into 6 to 8 fluid ounces of cold water, milk or other beverage. Stir, shake or blend until dissolved. For best results, mix up your shake 30 to 60 minutes after your workout or use as an anytime snack in your balanced diet.

Product Description

Optimum nutrition's gold standard 100% whey uses pure whey protein isolates as the primary ingredient. Combined with ultra-filtered whey protein concentrate, each serving provides 24 grams of all-whey protein and 5.5 grams of naturally occurring branched chain amino acids (BCAAs) which are prized by athletes for their muscle building qualities. With more than 20 tempting flavors to choose from, on gold standard 100% whey gives you plenty of ways to keep workout recovery interesting. Search "On apparel true strength" to see our new on clothing line.

Vanilla Ice Cream Flavor is worth every penny
I have been struggling with the protein search for about 10 years. I have never found a protein powder that I’ve actually liked. I’ve had this brand before the regular vanilla flavor and hated it, gave it away. I’ve tried fruit flavored ones that mix in water. Nothing worked, I hate the taste of protein. I made a protein shake today with just frozen fruit, milk and a scoop and a half of this. That’s it. Normally I put fresh fruit, frozen fruit, honey, peanut butter I put a whole bunch of stuff to make it taste better and it doesn’t. This time I was lazy and it was my first time trying it, absolutely amazing. I’m so impressed. If you care about taste and love vanilla, this is it highly recommend.

    5 out of 5 stars
    I Refuse to Drink Chalk
    Reviewed in the United States on February 26, 2026
    Flavor Name: Vanilla Ice CreamSize: 2 Pound (Pack of 1)
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    If your biggest fear is spending money on protein powder that tastes like drywall and regret... this one is solid!.

    I’ve been using this consistently for several months, mainly post-workout and occasionally as a breakfast shake. I’ve mixed it with water, almond milk, and once blended it into a banana smoothie to see how it behaves. So yes, this has been properly field-tested.

    For a vanilla protein, this is solid. It’s not overly sweet, not artificial-tasting, and doesn’t punch you in the face with fake vanilla. Mixed with cold milk, it actually tastes like a mild vanilla milkshake. With water, it’s lighter but still drinkable which is important because some powders only taste decent with milk.

    It dissolves easily in a shaker bottle. No stubborn clumps, no protein “floaters,” no sandy texture. 20–30 seconds of shaking and you’re good. The powder is fine and consistent. No weird smell when you open the container. It feels like a well-refined product, not something thrown together.

    It helps me hit daily protein targets more easily without cooking another full meal. I’ve found recovery feels solid after workouts when I stay consistent with it. This isn’t magic muscle dust...it’s a convenient protein source. Used properly alongside training and nutrition, it does its job.

    For the quality and brand reliability, the price is fair. You’re not paying bargain-basement rates, but you’re getting consistent quality and good mixability.

    NOTE: Use cold liquid and shake immediately after adding powder. Letting it sit before shaking increases the chance of clumps.

    This is one of the safer bets in the protein world. Good flavor, easy mixing, reliable quality. It’s not flashy, it’s dependable. And sometimes, that’s exactly what you want from your protein powder.

    One Powder to Bind the Weary Flesh After the Chicago Night Rolls
    Reviewed in the United States on February 15, 2026
    Flavor Name: Vanilla Ice CreamSize: 5 Pound (Pack of 1)
    Verified Purchase

    It was the hour when the mats of the North Side academy finally lay quiet, the last echoes of slaps and grunts swallowed by the low hum of the L train rumbling overhead, and the body—spent in the long war of guard and guard-pass—began its slow, unforgiving ledger. Six rounds, perhaps seven, each one a siege fought under fluorescent glare: hips escaped from beneath the crushing weight of purple belts, armbars defended with tendons that sang like frayed bowstrings, the air thick with the smell of rubber and sweat and the faint diesel ghost drifting in from Irving Park Road. By the time I stepped out into the February wind off the lake—sharp as a blade drawn across the knuckles—the quads trembled, the lats hung heavy as wet sailcloth, and the whole frame carried the dull thunder of effort that had no mercy in it.

    I drove south through the sodium-lit arteries of the city, past the shuttered taquerias and the glow of corner bars where men nursed their own quiet defeats, and in the small kitchen of the River Grove walk-up, under a single bulb that flickered like a dying beacon, I would once have stood empty, staring into the fridge as though it held some ancient pardon for the body’s complaints. Recovery was a word for other men, the ones who still believed flesh could forgive everything. Then the tub of Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard arrived—black and red as the banners of the Bears after a hard-fought Sunday, five pounds of vanilla ice cream promise sealed against the damp Chicago air. I leveled the scoop into the shaker with water from the tap—cold enough to bite—and watched the powder dissolve swift and clean, no stubborn clumps clinging like orcs to the walls, no chalky silt to remind me of lesser brands that had failed me before.

    I drank it slow against the counter, the taste rich and true: vanilla that carried the cool memory of ice cream scooped on summer nights at Montrose Beach, sweet without insult, smooth enough to quiet the fire still banked in the throat. The protein—24 grams per serving, 5.5 grams of BCAAs—began its work almost at once: the trembling eased first in the forearms, then crept down into the legs; the deep ache in the glutes softened from knife to murmur. Sleep came deeper that night, the kind where the city noise fades and the body mends without protest. Mornings after the brutal sessions—when the stairs up from the Blue Line once turned every step into accusation—I rose and found the quads compliant, the back straight without complaint, ready for the day’s ordinary Chicago treacheries: walking the dog along the Des Plaines, hauling groceries up three flights, surviving another rush hour on the Kennedy.

    It has become ritual now: post-training, the shaker rattled under the kitchen light; the slow walk to let blood return; the quiet hours when flesh remembers it can endure another dawn on these hard Midwestern streets. Soreness does not vanish—BJJ in Chicago grants no such illusions—but it is mastered, held in check, forced to wait its turn rather than rule the night entire. The powder endures like a loyal squire: no clumping in the humid summers that follow these winters, no settling into sludge at the bottom of the tub, no fading promise as the servings dwindle.

    If your nights on the mats leave you hollowed, if the body whispers surrender when the mind still hungers for more rolls under these gray skies—take this Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard. It is not mere supplement; it is covenant between warrior and recovery, a powder forged for the long campaign after battle in the city that never sleeps easy, the fellowship your weary frame has hungered for when the rolls are done and only the ache remains.

    Ten stars out of five, though the heavens are sparing with such reckonings. I would carry it into the deepest lairs of Mordor and fear no post-spar collapse on the frozen sidewalks of the North Side.

    🥤🧙‍♂️💪🌬️

About this Item

  • 24 g High-Quality Whey Protein per Scoop – 100% of the protein from whey for a fast-absorbing, complete protein source that supports muscle maintenance and growth.
  • 5.5 g Naturally-Occurring BCAAs + 11g of naturally occurring EAAs – Delivers essential amino acids including leucine, isoleucine, and valine to support post-workout muscle recovery, muscle strength and muscle building when taken over time with regular resistance training.
  • Low Sugar, Low Carb, Low Fat — Ideal for Lean Muscle or Cutting Phases – With just ~1 g sugar, ~3 g carbs per serving, and whey protein isolate as the primary ingredient with further carbs and fat “isolated” out. It’s a high quality choice for athletes focused on lean muscle, weight management, or body-composition goals.
  • Instantized & Easy-Mix Formula (Great Mixability) – Designed to dissolve smoothly in water, milk, or smoothies with a spoon, shaker, or blender — perfect for fast post-workout shakes or convenient protein boosts.
  • Trusted Brand, Tested Quality & Versatile Use – For 35 years, athletes have trusted Optimum Nutrition to fuel their training. Gold Standard Whey is the trusted choice for gym-goers, athletes, and everyday fitness enthusiasts worldwide — use post-workout or as a protein supplement anytime.

Product Description

Optimum nutrition's gold standard 100% whey uses pure whey protein isolates as the primary ingredient. Combined with ultra-filtered whey protein concentrate, each serving provides 24 grams of all-whey protein and 5.5 grams of naturally occurring branched chain amino acids (BCAAs) which are prized by athletes for their muscle building qualities. With more than 20 tempting flavors to choose from, on gold standard 100% whey gives you plenty of ways to keep workout recovery interesting. Important Information

Safety Information

For healthy adults, consume enough protein to meet your daily protein requirements with a combination of high protein foods and protein supplements throughout the day as part of a balanced diet and exercise program.

Ingredients

Protein Blend (Whey Protein Isolate, Whey Protein Concentrate, Hydrolyzed Whey Protein), Natural and Artificial Flavor, Sunflower and/or Soy Lecithin, Cellulose Gum, Xanthan Gum, Salt, Sucralose, Acesulfame Potassium. CONTAINS: MILK AND SOY.

Directions

Mix about one scoop of the powder into 6 to 8 fluid ounces of cold water, milk or other beverage. Stir, shake or blend until dissolved. For best results, mix up your shake 30 to 60 minutes after your workout or use as an anytime snack in your balanced diet.
